description: The Lawstronaut MCP gives AI agents real-time, structured access to global legislation, regulations, case law and legal metadata through a fast, developer-friendly Model Context Protocol server. Built for legal AI, compliance workflows, and enterprise automation, it delivers verified statutory data with jurisdictional coverage, citation integrity, and live updates, allowing you to ground your AI in accurate legal information.
